sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires ref:resolvable entity with attributes (component/body/face/occurrence/parameter), group:nonempty namespace string, name:nonempty attribute name, value:string. Discover refs with entity.list/entity.find. The group is a caller-declared namespace; names must be unique within a group.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Reusing an existing group/name updates it in place (Fusion Attributes.add semantics); the previous value is returned. Values are strings bounded by the Fusion attribute API; larger payloads must be split. Attributes persist on the next save; this operation does not save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass, operation:entity.attribute.set, documentIdentity:{creationId:string|null,name:string}, units:{}, frame:{space:component,component:reference}, associativity:durableAttribute, warnings:string[], method:string, limitations:string[], provenance:{requirement:GM29,source:docs/APPEARANCES.md}, affected:[{ref:reference,group:string,name:string,before:string|null,after:string}], result:{resourceIdentity:reference,group:string,name:string,value:string,previousValue:string|null,changed:boolean}. resourceIdentity is the actual owning entity reference, not a display-name guess.

examples.label: Tag a discovered body with source metadata
examples.requires: Earlier bodies: entity.list {kind:body}; standalone substitute the actual ref.
examples.output: result.changed=true on first write; result.resourceIdentity carries token/kind/name.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires ref:resolvable entity with attributes and group:nonempty namespace string; optional name:string. Omitting name lists the whole group via Attributes.itemsByGroup; providing name reads exactly one attribute.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: Read-only. Reads the named group only; other namespaces are not enumerated. The returned resourceIdentity is the actual owning entity reference.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass, operation:entity.attribute.get, documentIdentity, units:{}, frame, associativity:snapshot, warnings:string[], method, limitations, provenance, affected:[], result:{resourceIdentity:reference,group:string,attributes:[{name:string,value:string}],count:integer}.

examples.label: Read the source metadata group
examples.requires: Earlier bodies: entity.list {kind:body}; standalone substitute the actual ref.
examples.output: result.attributes lists every name/value in the group; result.count matches.
